task: Run a security audit and tell me if anything on the network needs attention.
reply:
The security audit found three issues needing attention:

1. High severity: Three sensitive entities (Security Alarm, Garage Door, Front Door lock) are exposed to Assist without a Critical Action PIN. It is recommended to enable the Critical Action PIN or unexpose these entities from Assist.

2. Low severity: No login-attempt threshold is configured, so IP banning never triggers after failed logins. It is recommended to enable IP banning and set a login attempts threshold in your configuration.

3. Low severity: One unconfigured device was discovered on your network (a DLNA device). You should configure it if it is yours, ignore if recognized and unwanted, or investigate if unknown.

Additionally, 19 other security checks could not run due to missing integrations or unavailable data. Addressing the above issues will improve your home security.
